findings.current: “Anyway, yes. I hope both of you are in excellent health.”
findings.defect: Taekyung repeats the mistaken wish that they be split in two; the draft gives the correct greeting, leaving no reason for the shocked reaction or his realization that he misspoke.
findings.rationale: He says 기체후일도양단, carrying Hyuk Mujin’s erroneous 일도양단 into the formal greeting.
findings.replacement: “Anyway, yes. I hope you’ve both been split in two.”
findings.source: 뒤늦게 말실수를 깨달은 나는 한숨을 푹 내쉬었다.

findings.current: He’d very nearly become the guest of honor at a funeral instead.
findings.defect: A guest of honor is not necessarily the dead person; Song Il nearly became the subject of his own funeral.
findings.rationale: 초상집의 주인공 refers to the deceased, not an honored attendee.
findings.replacement: He’d very nearly ended up being the one everyone mourned at a funeral instead.
findings.source: 바로 초상집의 주인공이 될 뻔한 그는

findings.current: Then they realized that the blue-eyed young man who’d suddenly appeared was none other than the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon, Jin Taekyung.
findings.defect: The draft invents blue eyes. 새파란 놈 describes a very young upstart, not eye color.
findings.rationale: The shock is at the newcomer’s identity despite his youth; no physical eye detail is supplied.
findings.replacement: Then they realized that the young upstart who’d suddenly appeared was none other than the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon, Jin Taekyung.
findings.source: 갑자기 나타난 새파란 놈의 정체가 바로 그 열화신룡 진태경이라는 것에 또 다시 한 번.

findings.current: “Gong Iljung of the Zhongnan Sect pays his respects to Great Hero Jeok.”
findings.defect: Gong does not introduce himself by his full name here. He uses the self-effacing 공 모, withholding his given name.
findings.rationale: The deliberately modest introduction precedes Jeok’s question about his name.
findings.replacement: “This humble Gong of the Zhongnan Sect pays his respects to Great Hero Jeok.”

findings.current: “G-Great Hero Jeok, please, for my sake and my Masters’…”
findings.defect: The draft changes Gong’s singular Master into multiple Masters.
findings.rationale: 제 스승님 is singular and identifies a specific relationship in his appeal.
findings.replacement: “G-Great Hero Jeok, please, for my sake and my Master’s…”
findings.source: “그, 적 대협. 부디 저와 제 스승님의 얼굴을 봐서라도…….”

findings.defect: Taekyung’s deliberately absurd attempt to tack politeness onto an informal yes disappears.
findings.rationale: 응이요 mixes casual 응 with the polite ending 요 in direct response to the complaint about his speech level.

findings.current: “I suppose I can. I might be young, but my seniority’s that of an old man.”
findings.defect: “I suppose I can” answers the Daoist’s rhetorical accusation as though it were permission or ability, obscuring Taekyung’s claim that his seniority entitles him to speak this way.
findings.rationale: 그래도 될걸 asserts that his behavior is permissible because his 배분 outranks his apparent age.
findings.replacement: “I can get away with it. I might be young, but in martial seniority I’m an old man.”

findings.current: “Oh! As expected of Young Lady Ju. Ten points to the Griffin-and-Phoenix Escort Bureau.”
findings.defect: The joke alters the established Yongbong Escort Bureau’s name by dropping its dragon half.
findings.rationale: 그리핀 is added to 용봉표국; it does not replace 용 with a griffin.
findings.replacement: “Oh! As expected of Young Lady Ju. Ten points to the Griffin Yongbong Escort Bureau.”
findings.source: “오. 역시 주 소저. 그리핀용봉표국에 십 점.”

findings.current: The rumor that Jeok Cheongang had broken through into a new, transcendent realm and regained his youth had spread far and wide.
findings.defect: “Transcendent” assigns a specific quality to the new realm that the source does not establish.
findings.rationale: 위대한 경지 calls the achievement great; it does not label the realm transcendent.
findings.replacement: The rumor that Jeok Cheongang had reached another extraordinary realm and regained his youth had spread far and wide.
findings.source: 적천강이 다시 한 번 위대한 경지를 개척하며 젊음을 되찾았다는 소문은 이미 퍼질 대로 퍼졌고

findings.defect: The draft reduces brazen refusal to mere slowness.
findings.rationale: 배 째고 있었구만 conveys a defiant, take-it-or-leave-it stance, consistent with Taekyung’s conclusion that the two elders held the sect back.
findings.replacement: *They’d dug in their heels and dared anyone to do something about it.*

findings.current: When I’d just started out as a Hunter, fresh from school and new to the job,
findings.defect: “Fresh from school” adds an educational history not stated in the source.
findings.rationale: 사회 초년생 means someone new to working life, not necessarily a recent graduate.
findings.replacement: When I’d just entered the workforce and started out as a Hunter,
findings.source: 내가 막 사회 초년생으로서 헌터 생활을 시작했을 때

summary: Several scene facts and relationships are altered, and the mistranslated greeting breaks a central joke.
